description: A `setupFiles` module that adds an `exit` listener to `process`, as a project's setup does to clean up after itself, over 12 test files in one worker (`maxWorkers: 1`; a `workerIdleMemoryLimit` makes Jest use a worker process even so). Twelve listeners on one `process` would pass Node's limit of 10 and print a `MaxListenersExceededWarning`. Each test's title holds the `exit` listener count its file saw; the run keeps the stderr lines naming the warning, and the totals, and captures `exit-from-setup.txt`, which the listener writes if it ever runs.
